content: Provide information about used memory resources. The NvM module configuration shall provide inform ation on how many resources of RAM, ROM and NVRAM are used. The configuration tool shall be responsible to provide detailed information about all reserved resources. The format of this information shall be commonly used (e.g. MAP file format).
